snippet.title: Spica Adventure - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Spica Adventure is a 2D side-scrolling arcade action game developed by ININ. Players must use their wits and quick reflexes to guide the heroine, Nico, through challenging stages filled with abstract and cartoony dangers. Packed with unique and charming retro pop art arcade aesthetics and unique music, players can also compete with online leaderboards support with other players worldwide. Spica Adventure is launching on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch in Spring 2024.
